redmodCli.requiredInvocationRule: Biology tooling must pass the Cyberpunk game root explicitly and validate REDmod output; exit code 0 alone is insufficient because attended probing proved root-ignore/no-mod false positives are possible.

playerFlow.prerequisite: Cyberpunk 2077 2.31 plus official REDmod support installed for the player's platform/store
playerFlow.firstInstall: close game; copy the game-root-shaped Biology release into Cyberpunk 2077 so mods/Biology lands intact; use the supported REDmod enable/deploy flow; launch normally through Steam
playerFlow.developerDeterministicDeploy: use tools/Deploy-BiologyRedmod.ps1 from the active Biology checkout after package installation; do not reconstruct raw redMod.exe quoting from historical chat/docs
playerFlow.normalLaunch: Steam / supported normal Cyberpunk launch after REDmod is enabled
playerFlow.update: close game; use biology/build-manifest.json as the prior exact ownership record; replace/remove only accounted Biology/dependency-owned files; install the newer package; redeploy REDmod when package content changed
playerFlow.disable: target: REDlauncher Enable mods OFF yields Biology-inactive vanilla-play behavior after issue #44 proves every supplemental route; disabling is not uninstall or save deletion
playerFlow.uninstall: target: self-contained Uninstall Biology.exe validates the owner manifest/hashes, removes only safely proven files, preserves saves/settings by default, and refreshes REDmod state

supplementalRuntime.ownershipRule: Supplemental files outside mods/Biology are owned/accounted per file. Their parent directories remain shared and are never recursively Biology-owned.
supplementalRuntime.settingsRemovalBlocker: Mod Settings remains the current accessible/persistent preference provider. ArchiveXL and RED4ext remain only transitively. Remove or gate the chain only through a current accepted provider/activation design; issue #44 owns launcher-off/hard-uninstall interactions.

ownerManifest.rule: Every ordinary installed payload file is listed exactly once. SHA256SUMS.txt hashes the finalized owner manifest and every final artifact file except SHA256SUMS.txt itself. Hard uninstall may remove only safely validated owned files and then empty owned directories.

conditionalSupplementalRoots.condition: Current Biology runtime is REDSCRIPT-BETTER. Exact files must be listed individually in the owner manifest.

cleanRoom.reason: The first REDmod-first structural milestone has completed its clean install/build/deploy proof. Future full reinstalls are reserved for structural changes, unexplained residue or deliberate release-level clean-room confidence; normal Biology removal is being moved to the manifest-safe player uninstaller.

rules: The repository root is not a player package.
mods/Biology is the authoritative first-party REDmod namespace.
Shared framework/game roots are never deleted wholesale, even when exact dependency files are bundled.
The playable builder may read the installed supported game for version/exact compilation but may not deploy or modify it.
If ownership/hashes/collisions cannot be accounted for, automated removal fails closed rather than guessing.
No successful CI/build result is live-game acceptance.
